## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +14.51%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +7.03%) provide upside while key risk-cycle ratios are flat/neutral (VIX/SPY_TLT/HYG_LQD NEUTRAL), supporting a balanced stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -9.67%) ↓ falling. Rates pressure: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -2.71%) ↓ falling implying higher yields. Credit neutral: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.06% | 1M: -0.11%) → flat.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Financial conditions broadly neutral: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +5.28%) → flat while TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -2.71%) ↓ falling tightens conditions marginally.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Tech leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +7.03%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +14.51%). Weak: Materials and Industrials lag—XLB BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.96%) and XBI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -3.43%). Style: Growth/Tech and Energy showing strength; broader style picture mixed.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed but resilient: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +5.28%). EM/China lag: EEM CORRECTION (1W: -2.60% | 1M: +5.16%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -2.34%) ↓ falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative tone tempered: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +3.48%) and IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +1.95%) show selective risk-taking while ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -1.99%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base metals soft: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -4.22% | 1M: +5.50%) ↓ falling. Precious metals weak: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.04% | 1M: -2.83%) ↓ falling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strength intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +7.03%) ↑ rising and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +4.93%) ↑ rising; oil proxies like USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +12.49%) supportive.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK and XLE both ABOVE TREND across timeframes. MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple large-cap/tech ETFs in CORRECTION (SOXX 1W: -1.51% | 1M: +23.68%; QQQ 1W: -0.22% | 1M: +10.68%; MTUM 1W: -1.90% | 1M: +10.31%) — short-term profit‑taking within a longer uptrend.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor XLE and XLK showing relative strength; reduce exposure to weak cyclicals/materials like XLB and XBI; monitor duration risk with TLT BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +7.03%), XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +14.51%). BEARISH: XLB BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.96%), XBI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -3.43%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +4.93%). BEARISH: PALL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -9.46%), URA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.61%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -9.67%) ~20 complacency marker; HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -0.06% | 1M: -0.11%; LQD 1W: -0.62% | 1M: -1.13%) ~0.80 signals credit health; watch XLK/financials dispersion as a growth vs value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, but risk-cycle ratios are flat so the market is balanced between continuation and consolidation. Tech (XLK) and Energy (XLE) showing relative strength while CORRECTION patterns in several large-cap/tech ETFs are the key divergence to monitor.
